Metadata.title: Parkfairy staff
Metadata.description: Review what people send in to Parkfairy.

SignIn.title: Staff sign-in
SignIn.description: For Parkfairy staff only. You will be asked for your two-factor code next.

TwoFactor.title: Two-factor verification
TwoFactor.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
TwoFactor.backupDescription: Enter one of the backup codes you saved when you set up two-factor authentication. Each one works once.

Validation.backupCodeRequired: Enter one of your backup codes

Forms.invalidSummary: {count, plural, one {# field needs your attention} other {# fields need your attention}}

AuthErrors.INVALID_EMAIL_OR_PASSWORD: The email or password is incorrect. If you’ve just signed up, first follow the link we emailed you.
AuthErrors.INVALID_CODE: That code is not valid. Try again.
AuthErrors.OTP_HAS_EXPIRED: That code has expired. Try a new one.
AuthErrors.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many attempts. Sign in again to get a new code.
AuthErrors.ACCOUNT_TEMPORARILY_LOCKED: Too many wrong codes. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
AuthErrors.INVALID_TWO_FACTOR_COOKIE: Your verification session expired. Sign in again.
AuthErrors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
AuthErrors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
AuthErrors.INVALID_BACKUP_CODE: That backup code is not valid or has already been used.
AuthErrors.INVALID_TOKEN: This link has expired or has already been used. Request a new one.

NotFound.title: We couldn’t find that page
NotFound.description: The link may be broken or the page may have moved.

Error.title: Something went wrong
Error.description: This page couldn’t be loaded. Please try again.

not-staff.title: This account is not staff
not-staff.text: These screens are for Parkfairy staff. Sign out and use a staff account, or go to the public site.

no-second-factor.title: Turn on two-factor first
no-second-factor.text: Staff screens only open for accounts with two-factor verification on. Turn it on from your account page on the public site, then sign in here again.

standing.enrolLink: Open your account page on the public site

forbidden.title: You can’t see this
forbidden.text: The server did not allow this request. Sign out and in again, and check that your account has two-factor verification on.

unavailable.title: This could not be loaded
unavailable.text: The server did not answer. Reload the page in a moment.

review.lastNote: What was last asked of the owner
review.ownersLead: Tax numbers show only their last three characters. Everyone paid a share is checked here.
review.ownersCaption: The listing’s owners and their details
review.proofs: Proof of the right to rent
review.proofsLead: Opening a document is recorded in the audit log, with your name.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.lead: Everything staff change, and every proof document opened. Newest first. It cannot be edited or deleted.
audit.caption: Audit log

AdminReview.own: You own, co-own or manage this listing, so someone else on the staff has to decide it.
AdminReview.notWaiting: This listing is not waiting for a decision. Its status is: {status}.

approve.heading: Approve
approve.text: The listing goes live, and the owners who are paid a share are marked verified.
approve.question: Publish this listing now?

changes.heading: Send back for changes
changes.text: The owner reads your note, fixes the listing and sends it in again.
changes.hint: Plain words, up to {max, number} characters. The owner sees this exactly as written.

approved.title: Listing approved
approved.text: It is live, and the owners will be told. The decision is in the audit log.

changes.title: Listing sent back
changes.text: The owner will be told and can send it in again. The decision is in the audit log.

AdminErrors.NOT_IN_REVIEW: Someone decided this listing already, or the owner took it back. The page now shows where it stands.
AdminErrors.OWN_LISTING: You own, co-own or manage this listing, so someone else has to decide it.
AdminErrors.OWNER_DETAILS_MISSING: An owner changed their details since they sent this in, and they are incomplete now: {owners}. The listing can’t go live until they are filled in; send it back instead.
AdminErrors.MFA_REQUIRED: Two-factor verification must be on for your account.
AdminErrors.INVALID_ORIGIN: This request did not come from this site. Reload the page and try again.
AdminErrors.SESSION_ENDED: Your session has ended. Sign in again; nothing you typed here was sent.
AdminErrors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many decisions in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
AdminErrors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
